source_units.text: One who breathes into your face has come up, rescuing from affliction. Watch the road; hold your waist firm; act courageously with great strength,
source_units.display_text: One who breathes into your face has come up, rescuing from affliction. Watch the road; hold your waist firm; act courageously with great strength,

source_units.text: The river gates were opened, and the royal palace collapsed.
source_units.display_text: The river gates were opened, and the royal palace collapsed.

source_units.text: The foundation was uncovered, and she was going up, and her slave women were being led away like doves murmuring in their hearts.
source_units.display_text: The foundation was uncovered, and she was going up, and her slave women were being led away like doves murmuring in their hearts.

source_units.text: Nineveh—her waters are like a swimming pool; they were fleeing and did not stop, and there was no one looking back.
source_units.display_text: Nineveh—her waters are like a swimming pool; they were fleeing and did not stop, and there was no one looking back.

source_units.text: Prepare a portion; tune a string; prepare a portion, Amon, who dwells among rivers, water around her, whose dominion was the sea and whose walls were water,
source_units.display_text: Prepare a portion; tune a string; prepare a portion, Amon, who dwells among rivers, water around her, whose dominion was the sea and whose walls were water,
